# `Q-13-6` — Sidebar `auto:` Matched No Documents

> A sidebar `auto:` entry expanded against the project index
> but matched no documents.

## What this means

A sidebar `auto:` entry asks Quarto to fill the sidebar with
every document matching a path or glob — `auto: posts/` for
everything under `posts/`, `auto: "**/*.qmd"` for every `.qmd`
in the project, and so on. This warning fires when the
expansion runs against a real project index but finds nothing.
The sidebar still renders; the `auto:` entry contributes no
items.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **The path or glob does not match any project file.** A
  typo, an off-by-one in a glob, or a directory that exists
  but is empty.
- **The directory holds only excluded files** — underscore-
  prefixed names, hidden directories, or files filtered out
  by `project.render`.

## How to fix

Confirm the path or glob points where you expect. From the
shell, expanding the same pattern (`ls posts/*.qmd`) shows what
Quarto sees — if the listing is empty there, fix the glob; if
files appear but Quarto still reports none, check the project's
exclusion rules.
